items.tr: iki yakasını bir araya getirmek, geçinmek
items.example: It's hard to make ends meet these days.
items.simple: You have just enough money to pay for the things you need.

items.example: Don't take your health for granted.
items.simple: You do not say thank you because you think it will always be there.

items.example: We want to raise awareness about plastic waste.
items.exampleTr: Plastik atık konusunda farkındalık yaratmak istiyoruz.
items.simple: You help many people learn about a problem.

items.example: That was a narrow escape. The car nearly hit us.
items.exampleTr: Kıl payı kurtulduk. Araba neredeyse çarpacaktı.
items.simple: Something bad nearly happened to you, but you got away just in time.

items.example: I deeply regret saying that to her.
items.simple: You feel very sad about something you did wrong.

items.example: It was bitterly cold this morning.
items.simple: So cold that it hurts your face.

items.example: Sometimes you have to take a risk.
items.simple: You try something that could go wrong, but could go well too.

items.example: We finally reached a decision after two hours.
items.exampleTr: İki saat sonra nihayet karara vardık.
items.simple: After thinking and talking, you choose what to do.

items.example: I strongly believe we can win.
items.simple: You are very sure that something is true.

items.example: I'm fully aware it's a risk.
items.exampleTr: Bunun bir risk olduğunun tamamen farkındayım.
items.simple: You know all about it, nothing is hidden from you.

items.example: Small things can make a big difference.
items.simple: Because of you, things get better or change.

items.example: It's hard to strike a balance between work and fun.
items.exampleTr: İş ve eğlence arasında denge kurmak zor.
items.simple: You give the right amount of time to each thing.

items.example: It'll save you money in the long run.
items.simple: After a lot of time, when you look back.

items.example: There was a sudden change in the weather.
items.simple: Something becomes different very fast, and no one saw it coming.

items.example: I got stuck in traffic for an hour.
items.simple: Your car cannot move because there are too many cars.

items.example: I had to pull an all-nighter for my exam.
items.exampleTr: Sınav için sabaha kadar uyumadan çalışmak zorunda kaldım.
items.simple: You stay awake all night to finish something.

items.example: I was on the verge of crying.
items.simple: You are almost doing something, just before it starts.

items.example: Don't draw a conclusion too fast.
items.simple: After you think about all the facts, you decide what is true.

items.example: Plastic poses a threat to sea animals.
items.exampleTr: Plastik deniz hayvanları için tehdit oluşturuyor.
items.simple: Something could hurt you or others, so it is dangerous.

items.example: We had a heated debate about money.
items.exampleTr: Para konusunda hararetli bir tartışma yaşadık.
items.simple: People talk in a loud, strong way because they feel strongly.

items.example: I vividly remember my first day at school.
items.exampleTr: Okuldaki ilk günümü canlı canlı hatırlıyorum.
items.simple: You remember it so clearly, like you can see it now.

items.example: I highly recommend this restaurant.
items.simple: You say it is very good and other people should try it.

items.example: I was bitterly disappointed with the result.
items.simple: Very sad because you hoped for something much better.

items.example: He's fiercely competitive at everything.
items.simple: He wants to win very, very much, even in small games.

items.example: He made a fortune selling old phones.
items.simple: You get a huge amount of money.
